title: Rho rail
description: A horizontal snap-scrolling row of cards with a pair of quiet chevron arrows centred underneath; the arrow at an end fades to 30%. Can turn into a plain grid from a breakpoint up.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows (hydrate: visible); swiping works without it
pass trackClassName to switch to a grid on desktop (and arrowsClassName="lg:hidden")
lines the first card up with the page column and lets the row bleed off the right edge
name: rho-rail

props.name: prevLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the left arrow

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the right arrow

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: extra classes for each card's slot (set its width here, e.g. "w-[85%] lg:w-[40rem]")

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: extra classes for the scrolling row, e.g. "lg:grid lg:grid-cols-3" to become a grid

props.name: gridOnDesktop
props.description: true when trackClassName turns the row into a grid from 1024px up (re-enables card reveals there)

props.name: arrowsClassName
props.description: extra classes for the arrow pair, e.g. "lg:hidden"
